en.headline: Worker falls unconscious from cargo ship deck at Tuen Mun River Trade Terminal
en.dek: A man in his fifties was taken to Tuen Mun Hospital after falling about 1.5 metres onto a ship deck around noon on Tuesday.
body: Police received a report at about 12:04pm on Tuesday that a male worker in his fifties had fallen from a height of about 1.5 metres onto the deck of a cargo ship at the Tuen Mun River Trade Terminal.
The man was found unconscious at the scene and was taken to Tuen Mun Hospital for treatment. Police have classified the case as an industrial accident and are investigating the cause.
Rescuers attended the terminal on Lung Mun Road. No other injuries were reported.

zh.headline: 屯門內河碼頭貨船工人從高處墮甲板昏迷送院
zh.dek: 一名五十多歲男工人周二中午約十二時在屯門內河碼頭貨船上從約1.5米高處墮下甲板，當場昏迷，送屯門醫院搶救。
body: 警方周二中午約十二時零四分接報，屯門內河碼頭一名五十多歲男工人懷疑在貨船約1.5米高處不慎墮下甲板，當場陷入昏迷。
救援人員到場後將傷者送往屯門醫院搶救。警方將案件列作工業意外有人受傷處理，正調查事故成因。
事發地點為龍門路屯門內河碼頭，現場未有其他人員受傷報告。
